context: Daichi is on solo-babysitting duty for his niece Hina, in his sister's apartment. They're about an hour in.
purpose: chaotic uncle-niece play — fond exasperation in both directions

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ひな、これ食べてええの？
lines.style: Holds the cookie up like exhibit A. Warm, playful Kansai lilt. The conspiratorial tone of someone about to break a small rule.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Instinctive authority-deferral, bright and bouncing. Eight-year-old logic: someone bigger should decide. Physical energy in every syllable.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Mock-tragic, already mid-bite. Kansai drawl stretches the complaint. The voice of someone who's already won the negotiation.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: …一個だけならいいよ、たぶん。
lines.style: Cautious, soft-spoken permission. The word 「たぶん」 lands as a tiny loophole she knows she's opening. Brief hesitation, then commitment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ナイス。よし、二人で内緒な。
lines.en: Nice. Alright — our secret, just us two.
lines.style: Drops to a mock-whisper, conspiratorial and warm. The voice of an uncle inviting her into something small and forbidden. Half-theatrical, entirely genuine.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Delivered like weathered wisdom. Matter-of-fact, unflappable. An eight-year-old stating the laws of physics. Zero doubt in her voice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: (laugh)本当に、お前、母親みたいに言うな。
lines.en: (laughs) You really do sound just like your mom.
lines.style: Big, unguarded Kansai laugh. Affectionate surprise. The laugh is genuine before the words even land. Sitting back, delighted by her.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ねえ、おじちゃん、一緒に絵描いて。
lines.style: Topic shift happens mid-breath. Already reaching for crayons. Bright demand that brooks no refusal. Complete eight-year-old certainty he'll say yes.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 俺、絵、めっちゃ下手やで。
lines.style: Pre-emptive disclaimer, half-laughing even as he's already sitting down. Kansai warmth beneath the protest. The objection of someone who's already capitulated.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: No mercy, no patience for his excuses. Hands him the crayons. The tone of an eight-year-old who knows exactly what she wants and expects him to deliver it.
